optionCodeEvidence.limitation: BAUDIO downstream speaker circuits are verified to named body and door connectors, but the right MCU upstream X171-2/1 option is PAUDIO in raw SVG despite merged metadata listing X051; do not assert it as BAUDIO. No physical filter component or source-to-branch internal controller circuit is shown.

recommendedMethod: OPTIONAL FULLY ACTIVE AFTER FACTORY SPLIT PROTECTION IDENTIFIED: professionally verified reversible cabin-side breakout preserving all unrelated circuits to isolate the OEM audio source and front woofer A/B while routing downstream tweeter pair to HELIX H/I. Do NOT claim factory provides separate active audio streams or that a named CAP branch by itself proves passive tweeter protection still exists after replacement.

amplifier.activeWiring: Only after independent circuits are verified ISOLATED: physical H drives dedicated left tweeter and physical I drives dedicated right tweeter. Amplified A/B drive ONLY independently verified BAUDIO front woofers. Never tie H into A nor I into B, and never connect H/I to original Tesla source outputs.
amplifier.crossover: H and I: HP 3500 Hz LR24, LP off, starting gain -18 dB, muted until verified; A/B woofer only: HP 65 Hz LR24 and LP 250 Hz LR24 only after physical separation is confirmed.
amplifier.inputRouting: Front L Full from ISA verified A+C sources, Front R Full from ISA verified B+E sources; use VCP matching physical speakers only after measurement; initial filters can be set with outputs muted.

factoryPathNote: BAUDIO option-coded harness confirms separate factory connector wires downstream of controllers but not separate factory-amplified streams. CAP-named tweeter branch location is defined at connector level only; no internal capacitor location shown. PAUDIO alt contacts excluded.
forbidden: DO NOT use PAUDIO X033A-5/6 or X053A-22/23 in this BAUDIO circuit.
DO NOT connect HELIX H/I to Tesla module-side/MCU-side factory audio power outputs; only connect to isolated downstream tweeter wire pairs.
DO NOT splice into, modify, or drill OEM door gaiter; no new wires through door are required if all existing BAUDIO cavities are physically populated.
DO NOT disturb/depinn airbag, door pressure sensor, latch or window-control signals; multiway body-controller connectors carry safety-relevant circuits.
DO NOT treat the new Highland harness sleeve 'Front Low/TW' as proof of an actual electrical parallel joint; use continuity checks.
DO NOT connect speakers or energize outputs until HP3500 LR24 has been saved, and OEM source isolation and amplifier load and polarity pass QC.

installationGates.label: Confirm the actual vehicle/build is LHD Highland SOP9 BAUDIO and connectors X033B and X053A correspond to the factory door connectors.
Export/backup existing V TWELVE DSP settings; mute physical H/I and set their 3500 Hz LR24 protective HP.
Follow Tesla LV safe-isolation instructions before disconnecting any multiway body-controller connectors. Do not touch HV/orange cables or SRS hardware.

At X565 and X575, unplug each tweeter and continuity test to *vehicle-side* BAUDIO X033B-1/2 and X053A-5/6, respectively, with vehicle power isolated. Observe contact-face orientation and actual populated cavities.
Use a verified keyed reversible adapter at the correct cabin-side multiway connector, preserve all unrelated functions and insulate OEM audio source to prevent amplifier-to-amplifier backfeeding.
Verify no electrical continuity between H/I tweeter return network and A/B woofer return circuits, OEM amplifier sources, vehicle chassis or each other.
Check both woofer loops X568/X578 remain connected to A/B only, and tweeter loops X565/X575 to H/I only.
With outputs muted, program final physical A/B woofer HP65/LP250 and H/I tweeter HP3500 LP OFF at LR24, initial safe attenuations; only then conduct low-volume channel tests.
Reinstall trims without pinched conductors or cable runs in airbag deployment zones, seat tracks, pedal linkages or door hinges; inspect door electrical/window/pressure sensor diagnostics.

factoryAudioSplitClarification.sourceOfTruth: Source_Assets/core/audio_lhd.svg option-coded BAUDIO LHD and associated Source_Assets/connectors/ X171 X031 X051 X033B X053A X053B
factoryAudioSplitClarification.confirmed: Original BAUDIO LHD electrical drawing shows front-woofer input wiring into body-controller circuits and separate downstream woofer and CAP-named tweeter connector pairs. It does not show two independently generated factory audio streams or a capacitor component. Internal controller connections and filter location are outside the scope of this harness schematic.

factoryAudioSplitClarification.physics: A single conventional analogue amplified pair carries one waveform. Two downstream pairs do NOT establish independent loudspeaker streams. A passive crossover might split the spectrum, or internal processing could exist, but no passive/active filter components are identified in this archived factory harness diagram.
factoryAudioSplitClarification.physicalFilterLocation: UNKNOWN. Label AUDIO_SPEAKER_CAP_FRONT_DOOR_PASSTHROUGH may be related to filtering or part nomenclature, but does NOT alone prove a discrete capacitor, whether filtering occurs inside BCM, on the harness, in the original tweeter, or upstream. Neither electrical harness SVG nor archived EPC speaker list includes capacitor value/symbol/location.
factoryAudioSplitClarification.crucialAfterReplacement: HELIX Ci7 T20FM-SC DOES NOT INCLUDE PASSIVE CROSSOVER IN STANDARD BOX. CFMK20 TES.1 is mechanical mounting ring only. Never assume Tesla OEM filter remains downstream when factory tweeter is replaced. If no verified suitable passive crossover, do NOT energize shared A/B output with bare tweeter.
factoryAudioSplitClarification.fullActiveAlternative: Separate H and I are new HELIX output channels: they require electrical isolation of factory A/B branch and OEM source from downstream tweeter wires at correctly validated cabin-side interposers. This changes the circuit; it is not how the factory supplies separate streams.

teslaEpcPart.interpretation: Part catalogue names a speaker family but does not prove component internals, fitted BAUDIO VIN variant or factory crossover placement.

factoryAudioSplitClarification.recommendedEvidence: Manufacturer internal controller PCB/service circuit drawing or removal/inspection of actual OEM tweeter and wire module is needed for positive capacitor/filter location. No such internal circuit is present in repository.
